role: Scans application source code for one specific tenant/user identity hardcoded as an always-allowed special case, rather than access being driven by role or permission data.
behaviorDescription: Walks a directory tree, scanning only .ts/.js files, for an identity variable (tenantId/userId/ownerId/accountId/requesterId/adminId/sub) compared directly — via === or .includes() — against a hardcoded UUID or email-shaped string literal, in either order. Deliberately excludes role/permission comparisons against role-name literals (e.g. role === 'admin'), since that is normal, legitimate authorization code, not a hardcoded individual override. Findings are crit severity, since a literal identity match is a plausible backdoor shape but needs human judgment to confirm intent rather than being auto-blocked. Computes a Perfection Index and signals the swarm whenever any match is found.
hardStops: Never writes to, deletes, or modifies any file — detection only
Only scans .ts and .js files — never JSON, to avoid false positives on config/content files
Never flags role/permission-name comparisons — only comparisons against a specific hardcoded UUID or email literal
Skips files over 2MB to avoid attempting to scan binaries or bundled output
